title: Bluetooth 7 Speeds Are Set to Quadruple in 2027, Especially for Audio
summary:
On Thursday, the Bluetooth Special Interest Group, the trade association that oversees Bluetooth, officially unveiled Bluetooth High Data Throughput, a flagship upgrade set to arrive as part of the Bluetooth Core 7.0 standard.
Bluetooth is still the most popular medium-to-short-range wireless standard for connecting devices.
The biggest change in this update is a new physical layer for Bluetooth.
Improvements in the physical layer can have very significant effects on all Bluetooth communications.
In this case, new modulation schemes let the physical layer handle data more efficiently and transmit more data at once, which is why the speed increases are so significant.

title: Just about anyone can rent access to White House IP addresses
summary:

That’s according to findings from the security firms Layer3 Intel and Synthient, which discovered residential proxy activity on the White House network.
At the White House, Layer3 Intel found that 28 residential proxy services routed traffic out of the network from October 5th to November 3rd.
“That pattern suggests a person rather than a public guest Wi-Fi network: someone regularly on the White House network late into the evening, whose device is infected with a proxy SDK,” Layer3 says.
Layer3 warns that the residential proxy is “public access,” adding that “anybody can obtain it by signing up to a public residential proxy service, paying a few dollars and sending requests through it.”
